user.title: Sign in to the EDC portal
user.description: Enter your credentials and the price received for one kWh of shared electricity.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to EDC again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved EDC credentials are no longer accepted. Enter the new password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the EDC portal.
error.no_groups: The account has no available sharing group.

abort.already_configured: This EDC sharing group is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The EDC credentials were updated successfully.

general.title: EDC settings
general.description: Group, price and default recipients/language for the original report buttons. Legacy schedules are shown until profiles are first saved; then manage schedules under Report profiles.

data.summary_report: Send a daily summary report (all periods in one email)
data.report_day: Day of month for monthly/current-year reports

data_description.report_targets: First go to Settings > Devices & services > Add integration and set up SMTP. Add the first recipient during setup; add more addresses later with Add recipient on the SMTP integration. Then select the resulting notify entities here.
data_description.report_language: Select the language used for email subjects and report contents.
data_description.yearly_report: Sends the year-to-date report every month on the selected day.
data_description.summary_report: Sends one email containing the daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly sections every day at report time. It can be enabled together with any separate reports.

profiles.title: Report profiles
profiles.description: Select a profile or ＋ to add one. Each profile has its own recipients, content, language and schedule.

profile_edit.title: Report profile settings
profile_edit.description: Reports contain totals for the configured group. The daily section always uses the latest available EDC day. Send now also works for paused profiles.

data.name: Profile name
data.combined: Combine selected periods in one email

data_description.targets: Create recipients under Settings > Devices & services > SMTP > Add recipient, then select their notify entities here.
data_description.period_mode: Current = this week/month/year. Previous = the last completed period. Legacy = previous week/month and current year.
data_description.day: Used for monthly and yearly sending.
data_description.only_new: Scheduled attempts skip unchanged data. Send now bypasses this check.

profile_delete.title: Delete profile
profile_delete.description: Delete profile {name}? EDC history will be retained.

profile_send.title: Send report now
profile_send.description: Submit to send profile {name} to all its recipients, even if paused or the data has not changed.

profile_status.title: Delivery status

error.already_configured: This sharing group is already configured.
error.invalid_profile: Enter a name, select at least one recipient and period, include energy or finance, and check the schedule.
error.report_failed: The report could not be prepared or handed off to all recipients. Check EDC availability and SMTP settings.

abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the EDC portal.
abort.invalid_auth: The EDC credentials are no longer valid.

backfill_history.name: Backfill available EDC history for the last year

revenue_today.name: Shared electricity value – latest available day
